name: saved_items_cap_is_a_conflict_and_is_not_retried
description: A free workspace's saved-items cap answers 409 lists.item_cap_reached. Nothing was added and waiting does not change that, so it is raised at once as a conflict, never as an idempotency conflict or a rate limit.

body.title: Saved-items cap reached
body.detail: Your workspace can save 100 items; 99 are saved and 2 would be added.
